# windle

> windle is a Solana protocol where teams back onchain-verifiable promises with collateral, a YES/NO market prices each promise, and at the deadline the chain decides: ship → collateral returned, YES paid; miss → collateral slashed to NO holders.

Status: pre-launch. Markets, prices and amounts shown on the website are illustrative, not live data. Collateral assets, minimums and fees are not decided yet.

## How it works

- [Promise](https://www.windle.fun/promise): a team makes an onchain claim anyone can verify, e.g. "Mainnet by Dec 1".
- [Collateral](https://www.windle.fun/collateral): the team locks funds it loses if it doesn't deliver.
- [Market](https://www.windle.fun/market): buy YES if you believe, NO if you don't; the price is the odds.
- [Incentive](https://www.windle.fun/incentive): the only insider is the team, and it profits only by shipping.
- [Judge](https://www.windle.fun/judge): at the deadline the chain checks the condition (program deployed, vesting untouched, revenue above N). No oracle votes, no disputes.
- [Outcome](https://www.windle.fun/outcome): ship → collateral returned, YES paid; slash → collateral to NO holders.
- [Ecosystem](https://www.windle.fun/ecosystem): built on Solana, works with pump.fun tokens.
- [Join](https://www.windle.fun/launch): make a promise or back a team.
